mentions.name: Project Builder
mentions.description: This self-hosted project builder scaffolds new app projects from a name plus a few configuration options (payments, analytics), generating a templated Terraform build that deploys to GCP and app stores in one to three clicks. It provides a dashboard for editing each project's code via code-server with hot reloading, running applications in a small Kubernetes cluster with one pod per project, and a Deploy button that updates the production Cloud Run service. Git and versioning support is a work in progress.
mentions.problem: Starting a new project eats cycles on boilerplate like auth setup, marketing pages, SEO, and mobile app release pipelines before real work begins.
mentions.audience: Spins up templated application builds with Terraform for one-click deploy to GCP and app stores.
mentions.source_excerpt: My project builder just takes a name, a few configuration options (do you need payments? Analytics?) and spits out a templated build with Terraform that I can 1 (okay maybe 3) click deploy to GCP + App Stores.
